---
title: "Search"
---

<section class="article-card">
  <p class="card-kicker">REPOSITORY SEARCH</p>
  <h1>Search</h1>
  <form class="site-search-page" action="search.html" method="get">
    <label for="search-query">Search research and articles</label>
    <div class="search-page-controls">
      <input id="search-query" name="q" type="search" placeholder="Search research &amp; articles...">
      <button class="btn-primary" type="submit">Search</button>
    </div>
  </form>
  <div id="search-results" aria-live="polite"><p class="search-status">Search is ready for future content.</p></div>
</section>
